purpose: Immutable text-source inventory and truthful reading coverage; not a media-validation or runtime-success record.

evidence_semantics.F: The fixed source text states this; author-reported observations/results are not independently remeasured facts.
evidence_semantics.D: M2 design rule derived from specified case text; conditional scope is retained.
evidence_semantics.full_text_read: Full text was semantically read for this task; no assertion that every source claim is correct.
evidence_semantics.selected_passages_read: Listed ranges or matching lines were semantically inspected; other prose only has machine coverage.
evidence_semantics.keyword_index_only: Full bytes were decoded, hashed and searched; matching excerpts supported retrieval, not comprehensive semantic review.
evidence_semantics.json_parse_node_inventory_and_selected_l: The JSON parsed; node inventory and named connections were inspected statically. No node implementation or pipeline was run.
evidence_semantics.translations: Translations and vocabulary expansions are derivative explanations, not additional independent experiments.

retrieval.keyword_pattern: (?:referenc\w*|identity|asset\w*|source\w*|autho\w*|Picture\s+\d|Audio\s+\d|Video\s+\d|Subject\s+\d|输入|素材|权限|参考|首帧|身份|音轨|未提供|不公开|不随|本地|口型)
retrieval.media_policy: Images, audio and video are excluded from reading, parsing and effect validation. Sparse-checkout absence does not establish remote absence.

semantic_review.selection: Reference declarations, identity separation, pose-library and continuity matches; not all intervening prose.

limitations: This inventory does not certify natural-language trigger behavior, permission-conflict resolution, source factual accuracy, H3 protocol compliance or generated media quality.
No original media was opened or analyzed; author-reported frames, durations, cut detections and beat analyses retain their attribution.
A referenced local Windows path, filename or ComfyUI loader widget is not proof that the asset was provided to the current task.
Rules and source disagreements are summarized in case-evidence.md; future user decisions must retain source and version instead of silently rewriting evidence.
